name: Tokenory Counter 3D
source_reference: tokenory-counter-3d.origin.png — user-supplied Things 3 reference for centred elevated perspective, converging sides, and a visible front wall.
brief: Three-dimensional orange enamel counter shown from a centred elevated camera. The complete casing and knob surround two fixed porcelain drums showing 64 and a blue-printed units drum stepping from 8 to 9. Editable source: tmp/work/Tokenory Counter.blend.

composer.reason: Physically shaded Cycles pass with curved drum printing, a recessed casing and optical occlusion; native editable geometry is supplied in the Blender scene.

png_fallback_evidence.evidence: The requested true perspective, reflections and mutual shading are generated by a 3D camera and surface materials.
png_fallback_evidence.cleanliness_check: The objects are rendered on transparent film as camera-separated passes with no tabletop or matte.
